## 4 · Setup script

Paste into the **Setup script** field. Runs once as root before the first
session; the resulting filesystem is snapshotted and reused, so later sessions
start fast.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
@@CLOUD_CACHE_BUST@@
set -euo pipefail

VALE_VERSION="3.9.1"
if ! command -v vale >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cd /tmp
  curl -fsSLO --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "https://github.com/errata-ai/vale/releases/download/v${VALE_VERSION}/vale_${VALE_VERSION}_Linux_64-bit.tar.gz"
  tar -xzf "vale_${VALE_VERSION}_Linux_64-bit.tar.gz" -C /usr/local/bin vale
  chmod +x /usr/local/bin/vale
fi

if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cd /tmp
  # Resolve the latest gh tag via the /releases/latest redirect, then download the
  # binary — same github.com host + install style as vale above (a setup script is
  # snapshotted once, so "latest" is fine and needs no pin). Reliable regardless of
  # the base image's apt repos; `apt install gh` is not (gh isn't in default repos).
  GH_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/latest" | sed -E 's#.*/tag/v##')
  curl -fsSLO --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v${GH_VERSION}/gh_${GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
  tar -xzf "gh_${GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" -C /usr/local/bin --strip-components=2 "gh_${GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin/gh"
  chmod +x /usr/local/bin/gh
fi

if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # jq is a single static binary — fetch it from the jqlang release (same github.com
  # host + snapshot-once rationale as vale/gh above). context-fetch blocks that post-process
  # curl output with `| jq …` need it present, and the base image may not ship it; the
  # bkit-managed reference blocks avoid jq for that reason, but consumer blocks often use it.
  curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/download/jq-1.7.1/jq-linux-amd64" -o /usr/local/bin/jq
  chmod +x /usr/local/bin/jq
fi

@@CLOUD_WORKSPACE_TRUST@@

@@CLOUD_USER_SETTINGS@@

@@CLOUD_COREPACK@@

@@CLOUD_CONTEXT_FETCH_PROVISION@@

echo "cloud env ready: $(vale --version), $(gh --version | head -1), jq $(jq --version), pnpm $(pnpm -v)"
```

Keep total runtime under ~5 minutes or the snapshot won't build. `pnpm install`
and `vale sync` are **not** here — they belong in `.claude/hooks/cloud-bootstrap.sh`
(installed by `bkit install --auto=claude`) so they re-run on resumed sessions.

## 5 · Verify (first session)

```bash
vale --version && gh --version && jq --version && pnpm -v
```

Then confirm workspace trust. Unset, Claude Code ignores every `permissions.allow`
row in `.claude/settings.json` and reports it on stderr only, where no cloud
session shows it:

```bash
jq -r --arg p "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" \
  '.projects[$p].hasTrustDialogAccepted // "MISSING"' "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME}/.claude.json"
```

`true` = allow rows apply. `MISSING` = this container clones to a different path
than the setup script baked in; `.claude/hooks/cloud-bootstrap.sh` warns each
session — re-paste the setup script to fix the snapshot.

Your `/bkit-*` skills and bkit subagents load automatically from the committed
`.claude/` mirror — nothing to configure for those.
